name: Blown
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' blown bore: one delay line closed by an inverting reflection, driven by a clipped reed and a breath pressure the noise rides on. Its tone filter sits outside the loop, so the body colour and the pipe are separate controls.

controls.label: Body
controls.description: Braids' COLOR: the corner of the body filter the bore is heard through. Its live travel narrows with the note.

controls.label: Focus
controls.description: Braids' TIMBRE: how much noise rides on the breath. Low is turbulent, airy and quiet; high is steady and loud.

controls.label: Blow
controls.description: Mouth pressure, which Braids welds at 0.8. Down for an under-blown pipe, up to drive the reed into its clip.

controls.label: Reed
controls.description: The reed's rest offset, which Braids welds at 0.7. Down for a loose reed, up for one pinned open most of the cycle.

outputs.main: The bore heard through the body filter, which is what the module emits.
outputs.aux: Mono: the raw bore pressure, before the body filter. Stereo: a second pickup 0.62 of the way down the same bore, through its own copy of the body filter, so the two channels are one standing wave heard at two points.
